source.title: Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: President, the presiding officer, and senator-judges of the impeachment court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The sergeant at arms is directed to make a proclamation.

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: All persons are commanded to keep silent under pain of penalty while the impeachment court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is hereby called to order. Let's bow our heads and pray. Heavenly Father, we thank you for the gift of another day and another opportunity to do your will. We gather in this August Chamber to fulfill our constitutional duties as senator-judges and serve the people from whom we owe our mandate. Lend us your wisdom. Keep us from acting out of self-interest and set our sights only on the pursuit of justice. The strengthening of our democratic institutions and the creation of good governance for future generations.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Buksan mo ang aming isip, puso at diwa sa katotohanan. Gawian mo kami na ipagtanggol namin ang batas at higit sa lahat kung ano ang tama. This we pray in your holy name. Amen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Clerk of Court will now call the roll.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Trial suspended.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Clerk of Court will now call the roll.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Roll call up members, Sen. Judge Aquino, Sen.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Judge Cayetano Alan, Sen. Judge Cayetano Pia, Sen. Judge De La Rosa, Sen. Judge Ejercito, Sen. Judge Estrada, Sen. Judge Go, Sen. Judge Hontiveros, Sen. Judge Lacson, Sen. Judge Lapid, Sen. Judge Legarda, Sen. Judge Marcoleta, Sen. Judge Marcos, Sen. Judge Padilla, Sen. Judge Pangilinan, Sen. Judge Sotto III. Senator Judge Tulfo Erwin, Senator Judge Tulfo Raffy, Senator Judge Villanueva, Senator Judge Villar Camille, Senator Judge Villar Mark, Senator Judge Zubiri, The Presiding Officer Senator Judge Escudero, The Senate President Senator Judge Gatchalian.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: With 13 Senator Judges present, the Chair declares the presence of a quorum. In accordance with the Rules of Procedure on Impeachment Trials, the Chair now recognizes the newly elected Presiding Officer to preside over the proceedings of the Impeachment Court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Senate President. If there are no objections, we shall dispense with the reading of the November 19, 2026 Journal of the Senate, sitting as an impeachment court, and consider the same. That's approved. The clerk will please call the case before the impeachment court.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Case number 004-2026, in the matter of impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Appearances.

turns.speaker: Rep. Terry L. Ridon
turns.text: Good morning, Your Honors. For the prosecution, we are ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Good morning, Honorable Ridon. For the respondent.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Good morning, your honors. Same appearance for the respondent accused.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Who will handle the next witness, Dr. Rodolfo Atty. Sheila?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: It will be Atty. Justin Nicol Gular, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Justin, on the part of the prosecution?

turns.speaker: Rep. Terry L. Ridon
turns.text: Atty. Matib, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty.

turns.speaker: Rep. Terry L. Ridon
turns.text: Atty. Erwin Matib, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Erwin.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Justin, good morning. Call your witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, your honor. Good morning. For our next witness, your honor. May we call to the witness stand Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly situate Mr. Rodolfo to the witness stand. Clerk is directed to administer the oath as soon as he is so situated.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: While he is on his way to the witness stand, Chair would like to place on record in relation to the testimony of the witness yesterday. For the information once again of the parties, the senator judges, and the public. that the AMLC records offered and admitted by the court together with the other exhibits were classified under the order of this court on November 6, 2026 and the AMLC records are classified as sealed and under supervised access for senator judges, the parties, and authorized individuals only for the information and guidance of all concerned. Clerk may proceed with administering the oath.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Sir, kindly raise your right hand. You, Ceferino S. Rodolfo, do swear that the evidence you shall give in the case now pending between the Philippines and Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte shall be the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth. So help you God.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: I do.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly sit down. Dr. Rodolfo, ano po inyong palayaw kung paano namin kayo i-address?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Honorable Judge Perry po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Perry?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And you are a doctor because you have a doctorate or you're a medical doctor?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Doctorate po in Public Administration, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Dr. Perry, naunawaan niyo po ba inyong pinanumpaan kaugnay sa testimonyang ibibigay niyo sa harap ng impeachment court na ito?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Opo, Honorable Judge.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Salamat po. Kindly make your offer, Atty. Justin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: What is the pleasure of Sen. Judge Erwin with the indulgence of Atty. Justin?

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Mr. Presiding Officer, good morning and to all the Senator Judges. Ako po ay magtatanong sa sana and I'd like to comment

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: regarding these statements na binibitiwan po ng tagapagsalita po ng vice-presidente si Atty. Panelo discrediting witness credibility ng mga senator-judges. Can we do something about this, Mr. Presiding Officer? I mean, he's not party to this case, pero siya po ang tagapagsalita ng vicepresidente. Tama po ba yun? I mean, parang, I believe, parang meron mong problema po rito. I mean, you are the spokesperson of the vicepresident na on trial here, and then magkukomento ka hinggil sa mga senator judges, the impeachment court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: E

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: parang namang wala pong respeto sa ikang impeachment court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Mr. Presiding Officer, what can we do about this?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Panelo is neither a lawyer of record nor a witness to this impeachment court. Neither is he a party and therefore not covered by Rule 18. However, given the suppletory application of the Rules of Court, particularly Rule 71 on contempt, He may be covered or under the authority of this Court not under Rule 18 of our Impeachment Rules but under Rule 71 of the Rules of Court and therefore susceptible to any orders that this Court may issue us against him in relation to speech or action made by him in connection with this Impeachment Court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Yes, presiding officer. May I suggest that we ask for his explanation or probably summon in this court? Kasi hindi yung maganda tignan being the spokesperson. Baka nakakalimutan niya on trial here is yung boss niya, yung vice president and he's the spokesperson. Parang hindi naman po yata tama, Mr. presiding officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: While the presiding officer is not

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Prepared to say that the rules on agency would apply given that he is the spokesperson of the respondent, the chair will instead use simply the suppletory application of Rule 71. And if I understand the motion, instead of asking him to explain, it will be in the form of a show-cause order. Honorable Senator Judge Erwin, is that your pleasure, sir?

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Yes, Mr. Presiding Officer, that's my point, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: I will therefore file a motion to issue a show cause order for the spokesperson of the Vice President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Upon motion, there being no objection.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Motion is hereby approved. Clerk of Court is directed to issue a show cause order to Attorney Paolo Panelo, in regard to his remarks made yesterday afternoon, if I'm not mistaken. Yes,

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Mr. Presiding Officer. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Justin, your offer again.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Thank you. Turning back to my offer, Your Honor. Again, we are offering the testimony of the witness for the following purposes. Number one, that he is the Department of Trade and Industry, or DTI, Undersecretary for Industry Development and Investment Promotion. and as well the vice chairman and managing head of the board of investments number two pursuant to his authority under board resolution number 28-02 series of 2016 he issued CALE88 foods corporation certificate of registration number 2021-186 As an export enterprise engaged in PSIC 10309 manufacture of food products, export of producer of banana chips. Number three, CALE88 Foods Corporation is a duly registered export enterprise with a board of investments and is engaged in the lawful and legitimate business of producing and exporting banana chips. 4. That as a duly registered export enterprise with a board of investments, Calia 88 Foods Corporation is legally entitled to the following incentives. 1. Income Tax Holiday 2. Special Corporate Income Tax 3. Duty Exemption 4. VAT Exemption and Zero Rating Number 5, to disprove the material allegations under Article 2 of the Articles of Impeachment and the supposed forensic report of Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera to identify documents as well as to testify on matters related to the foregoing.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Comment.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. For offer number one, we stipulate with regard to the position of this witness in the DTI. We We are amenable to stipulate on that. As to the rest, subject to cross, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Justin, you may proceed accordingly in regard to the stipulation already made as to the qualification, position, and current job of the witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Understood, Your Honor. Thank you for the stipulation, Attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sir, para lang po. I'm sorry. Good morning, Doc.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Doc? Can you please tell us para malamang na natin what the Department of Trade and Industry is?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: The DTI is a national government agency po that is in charge of several functions including number one yung consumer protection and number two po yung international trade relations po natin. Tapos number three po as it relates po dun sa grupo kung saan ako nakabilang. Yun pong tinatawag natin na industry development and investment promotion.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. And sir, how long have you been connected with the Department of Trade and Industry, sir? If you could please tell us.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Sa pagkakaalala ko po, ako po ay naupo bilang una assistant secretary noong March 2013. Tapos po na-appoint po akong Undersecretary noong February 2016. Tapos hanggang ngayon po nandun po ako sa position na ito. Nabago lang po ng konti yung ginagampanan kong tungkulin. Pero dito po sa pinag-uusapan ngayon yung pagiging Managing Head ng Board of Investments since February 2016.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. You mentioned about your position in the Board of Investments, sir. Para lang po malaman at maintindihan po nating lahat, ano po itong Board of Investments, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ang Board of Investments po, ito yung tinatawag natin na Lead Investment Promotion Agency ng gobyerno. Pag sinabi po nating investment promotion, Ang pananaw po namin dito ay hindi lang po siya promotion na marketing. Napakalaga ho na yung pagtingin namin dun sa promotion ay capital letter P. Meaning promoting the development of industries. Kasama po dyan yung policies, kasama po dyan yung capacity development, at saka po yung promotion. Kadugtong lang po yun.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Dagdag ko lang po. Ginagampanan ng Board of Investments yung pong pag-promulgate ng Strategic Investment Priorities Plan na doon po ay sinasabi po kung ano yung mga activities na priority ng gobyerno for incentives under the different incentive laws po ng gobyerno kamukha po ng Create More Law.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Ano po ang relasyon between the DTI and Board of Investments kung mayroon man, Sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yung DTI po ang mother agency ng BOI. Kami po ay attached sa DTI. Ang kalihim po ng DTI ay nagsisilbing chairperson ng Board of Investments.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Maraming salamat po, Sir. Sir, pakiulit na lang po. Sorry, Atty. Erwin, I know this is stipulated but I'll just ask the witness. Dito po sa DTI, ano po yung position nyo?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ako po ay Undersecretary for Industrial Development and Investment Promotion.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, in relation to your position as an Undersecretary in the Department of Trade and Industry, ano po yung duties and responsibilities natin, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Kasama po dito yung pag-oversee ng several bureaus po. Isa po ay yung Export Marketing Bureau. Yung isa po ay yung Bureau of Import Services. Tapos po ang isa po where I also serve as the head of agency ay yung Board of Investments.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Na-stipulate na rin po na ikaw po yung Vice Chairman and Managing Head ng Board of Investments. Pwede niyo po bang sabihin sa amin kung ano yung duties and responsibilities niyo kaugnay sa position na iyan, Sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Basically po, as Managing Head ng Board of Investments, eto po yung day-to-day operation ng Board of Investments supervising apat na Functional groups sa Board of Investments. Meron po tayong Management Services Group. Meron po tayong Industry Development Services Group. Meron po tayong Investment Promotions Group. At saka po, meron din po tayong Investor Assistance Services Group.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Maraming salamat, Sir. Sir, may sapi na pong in-issue yung Impeachment Court sa inyo at sa opisina nyo. In-instruct po kayo mag-produce ng certified true copies. Ang unang tanong po, kaugnay sa mga sapina na yun, ano yung mga letters na pinadala nyo sa impeachment court kaugnay sa pagsumite ng mga dokumento, sir? Kung mayroon man.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Meron po tayong pinadalang letter, November 18, addressed to the honorable presiding officer ng court po in compliance of the sapina. Enumerate ko po yung mga pinadala naming dokumento, subpoena documents.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sige po. Let's go to that letter dated November 18, 2026 po. Ano po ang mga nakasabi ng mga dokumento na ipinadala ng opisina niyo sa impeachment court na ito, kung mayroon man sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Opo. Letter A po ay BOI Certificate of Registration No. 2021-186 dated December 9, 2021, issued to CALE88 Foods Corporation. Letter B po yung site inspection report. Letter C, report submitted by the firm on the project start of commercial operations. Letter D po ay yung annual reports consisting of the following. Form S1 for taxable years 2023, 2024, and 2025. Audited financial statements for Taxable Year 2023, 2024, 2025. Letter E po ay VAT Zero Rating Certification for Taxable Year 2024 and 2026. Attached with Application Form, Bank Certification of Deposit and Sales Report. Letter F, Letter Request for Endorsement of Good Standing dated April 29, 2026. Letter G, travel order for site inspection approved on April 29, 2026. Letter H,

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: report on site inspection undertaken on May 18, 2026. Letter I, endorsement of good standing dated June 16, 2026. Letter J, Certificate of Income Tax Holiday Incentive Entitlement issued to CALE88 Foods Corporation for taxable year 2024. Letter K, Letter Request for Change in the Ownership dated July 8, 2026 with the following attachment, General Information Sheet for 2024 and 2025. and letter L, letter of approval of the request for change in ownership.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Maraming salamat po, sir. Sir, sa baba, can we just request the tech not to take it down? Sa baba po ng letter na iyon, meron pong, there is a signature above the printed name, Dr. Ceferino Rodolfo po. Kaninong lagda po iyan kung alam niyo?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Sa akin po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Ano po yung dokumento na sinubintin nyo sa impeachment court? Certified true copy or original ba?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Certified true copies po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, we would just like to manifest that we will be marking the Board of Investments letter dated November 18, 2026 to this impeachment court and we request that it be marked as Exhibit D-2-1-CALE88, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So ordered.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Justin, we are also in receipt of a letter dated November 20, 2026 signed by the witness as well with the corresponding list of documents.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: I'm going there, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Do you have a copy of that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. I have been furnished by the court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Erwin, do you have a copy of that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay. So you're going there?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. But we would like to manifest that we just received the letter and the attached documents this morning, Your Honor. Just for the record, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, we also received it and it was dated on even date.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: May I proceed with my direction?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sir, bukod sa BOI letter dated November 18, 2026, ano pong ibang letter ang ipinadala nyo sa impeachment court na ito patungkol sa pinanana-issue ng impeachment court na ito po? Kung mayroon man.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Mayroon po. Naka-date nga ako ng November 20, 2026. Kanina lang po namin inaabot po ito. Again, addressed to the Honorable Francis Escudero as the Presiding Officer of this Honorable Court. We have submitted the following documents. Number one po, memo request for printing of the Certificate of Registration dated December 14, 2021, signed by the

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Our BOI Extension Office in Davao. Chief, si Gil Dureza.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Number 2. Sir, pardon, sorry to cut you. May we just request, Your Honor, that the document be flashed as well. I understand this was just recently.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The tech is so instructed.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sorry.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: By the way, continuing authority, or rather authority and continuing authority to assisting counsel to approach with this at any point in time during this testimony is given.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: We are requesting that the letter dated November 20, 2026.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: It's not this. Tech, it's not this.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: It is not the same document.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: It is the letter dated 20 November 2026. I think the

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: USB, Your Honor, is still with the court. Or, it's there.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: In any way, Your Honor, just as not to delay the proceedings, I will proceed, Your Honor, with a hard copy with the witness.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You have a copy of the USB, Counsel?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor, we confirm. Sir, pardon, let's just continue. Can you please enumerate? The documents contained in the letter dated November 20, 2026 of the Board of Investments as you have mentioned earlier.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Number one, memo request for printing of the certificate of registration dated December 14, 2021. Number two, final compliance with prerequisites for issuance of certificate of registration. Number three, BOI approval letter dated December 7, 2021. And number 18, Basic Information on Approved MSE Project or Micro and Small Enterprise Project, CALE88.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Maraming salamat, sir. Sir, sa baba ng letra na yan, sa letter na yan, there again appears a signature above the printed name, Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo. Whose signature is that, sir, if you know?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yung letter po ako yung pumirma.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And what is the nature of that document, sir? Is it original or certified?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Certified true copies po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, we request that the Board of Investments letter dated November 20, 2026 be marked as Exhibit D-2-1-A-CALE88 for the defense, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So ordered. Before you proceed, Atty. Justin, Atty. Erwin? Are you willing to stipulate as to the authenticity existence of these documents as well as the fact that they are part of the official records?

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. We're willing to stipulate.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: In order to avoid or obviate individual identification by the witness of the separate documents?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Your Honor, may I just clarify the extent of the stipulation of the prosecution? Are they willing to testify that the documents Stipulate that the documents submitted by the Board of Investments by virtue of the subpoena with respect to their existence, authenticity, and due execution.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: We are willing to stipulate that these are public records and therefore there is no need to have the witness identify and authenticate the signatures in these documents.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Pardon, Your Honor. I will have to request for a clear stipulation. The request for stipulation from the defense is that the documents submitted are authentic, That they exist and that they are duly executed or they're due execution wrong. Otherwise, we would be constrained.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I think that's fair, Attorney Erwin, but not as to the truth of the facts stated in those documents.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Only that they were submitted to the BOI in the regular course of business and operation, both of CALE88 and of the DTI and BOI.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Would that be satisfactory, Attorney Justin?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
