Now, on the same document, sir, still on Certificate of Registration Number 2021-186, dated December 9, 2028, issued in favor of CALE88 Foods Corporation, it states that, and I quote, PSIC 10309, manufacturer of food products, in close parenthesis, new export producer of banana chips. Para sa amin po na hindi masyadong pamilyar, ano ang ibig sabihin ng PSIC 10309, Sir? What does that stand for?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito po yung Philippine Standard Industrial Classification Code or System sa atin pong Philippine Statistics Authority.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Meron pong mga specific codes that corresponds to specific industries. Para po pag naglilikom sila ng mga reports, tama hong maiswak yung mga numero, yung mga data doon sa particular activity na iyon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Maraming salamat sir. Now puntahan po natin yung bottom portion ng Certificate of Registration number 2021-186 dated December 9, 2021. It states and I quote, The aforementioned registered project or activity is entitled to the following incentives. Income tax holiday, special corporate income tax, duty exemption, and VAT exemption and zero rating. Bago po natin puntahan yung bawat na incentives na yan sir. Gusto ko lang po at namin malaman, bakit po ba binibigyan natin ng mga incentives yung mga export enterprise natin?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Dahil po sa nakakapag-generate po sila ng trabaho, dahil po sa tingin natin yung value addition po dito sa mga ginagawa po nila ay may kinabang po ang ekonomiya po natin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And just to give us an idea sir, how many export enterprises do we have in the Philippines currently?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: I don't have the data currently with me po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay, that's okay sir. Next. Let's go specifically to the incentives. It states there that CALE88 Foods Corporation is entitled to income tax holiday. Ano po yung meaning ng income tax holiday, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yung income tax holiday po ibig sabihin po, so pag nag-ooperate ka, meron ka pong kita, may revenue ka, ileles mo po yung mga cost mo, pagkatapos po sa pinakababa po, meron kang net income. Yung net income mo po ordinarily kung hindi ka nakaregister for incentives, you will be subjected to an income tax. Yung income tax po natin pagka ang alam ko po sa CREATE law, 25% yun yung normal income tax, nagiging 20% po pagka micro-small enterprises ka po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: hindi niya po kailangan bayaran yun.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sinabi niyo po na 20% if SM... On the part of CALE88, kasi sinabi dito na entitled siya to income tax holiday, what is the repercussion? Ano pong epekto nito?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi po siya magbabayad ng income tax. Sa limbawa po, pag nag-start na po siya ng commercial operation, kung ano man po yung net income niya na dapat masubject ng 20% income tax, hindi na po niya babayaran yun for a period of 6 years.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Actually, that was my next question, sir. Next, sir. Okay. So, just to confirm, sir, the income tax holiday that CALE88 Foods Corporation is entitled to, how long, sir? Just for the record.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Anim na taon, po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. And yung anim na taon, san po yan rekond, po?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Sa date ng start of commercial operation, po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So, hindi sa issuance ng Certificate of Registration?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Just for clarifications.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Hindi po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. Next. Yung pangalawang benefit na nakasabi dito or incentive to be accurate is special corporate income tax. Again sir, para maunawaan natin, ano po ang ibig sabihin itong special corporate income tax?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Pagkatapos niyang ma-exhaust yung 6 na taon na income tax holiday, susundan po yun, magbabayad na po siya ng tax. Pero ang tax na babayaran niya po ay special. Ito pong tinatawag natin na SCIT for 10 years. Ang SCIT po ay 5% tax on gross income.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. Now, sinabi niyo po na SCIT is, the entitlement to SCIT is 10 years. When do you recon the start of that 10 years, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: After po mag-expire yung... ITH, yung income tax holiday.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes sir, please continue sir.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: So on the 6th year from start of commercial operation, yun po yung last year na may kinabang po siya dun sa totally walang income tax. On the 7th year, magsisimula na po yung 5% tax on the gross.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes sir. And for the record sir, if you just know, when was the actual start of operations of CALE88 Foods Corporation?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Check ko lang o sandali.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes sir, of course.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Initially po sa application nila sa atin, sabi niya po ang start of commercial operation niya ay January 2022 pero pinamove niya po to January 2023. So ang reckoning po namin January 2023.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes sir. So on the basis of that document sir, stating that the Actual start of operations of CALE88 Foods Corporation is January 1, 2023. Until when is it entitled to an income tax holiday?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And until when is it entitled to a special corporate income tax?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: So that will be 2029 to 2038.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. Pasensya na pa-compute ko po kayo. Next, sir. It also states that one of the incentives given to CALE88 Foods Corporation is duty exemption. Can you please explain to us po what this duty exemption means?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Kung dito po sa create law, pagka po mag-i-import siya ng mga capital equipment, exempted po yun from paying duties o mga taripa.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At bakit po binibigyan natin ng duty exemption itong mga export enterprise natin?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Again, kasama po ito dun sa mga incentive para sa mga sectors and activities that we are promoting.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Next is a VAT exemption and zero rating, sir. Can you please explain to us what a VAT exemption and zero rating means?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Mahalaga po ito dahil po ordinarily, Magbabayad ka po yung supplier mo po kasama doon sa mga ibibili sa iyo na pag bumili ka ng materyales kasama po yung VAT. Ipapasa niya po sa iyo yun. Pagka meron kang VAT zero rating na certificate, yun pong supplier mo hindi ka na pagbabayari ng VAT. So I think 12% din po yung VAT na yun. So makakatipid ka po doon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. And ano po ang entitlement ni CALE88 sa income tax, holiday, special corporate income tax, duty exemption, and VAT exemption zero rating to this day, sir?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Are they still entitled to those?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yes, po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, you mentioned we also tackled all these incentives, sir. Now, what relation do the specific terms and conditions and the general terms of conditions That you produced in your subpoena have to those incentives, sir? Ano po ang relasyon nila?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yun pong specific terms and conditions niya. Kailangan po compliance siya dun sa mga inagreehan niya ho na specific terms and conditions para maging eligible po siya dun to receive the incentives.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At ano naman po yung, meron din po kasi akong nakitang dokumento na general terms and conditions. Ano po yung pagkaiba niya sa special terms and conditions?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yung general terms and conditions, ito po yung applicable sa lahat. Pero para sa project na po ito, dahil doon siya sa specific item po na export producer, so ito po yung requirement. As it applies to the project po, ito po yung requirement niya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: The next document we'll discuss, sir, is the external contact report or plant visit. We request the tech to prepare the document as well. You confirm na isa din po ito sa mga dokumento na you submitted to this impeachment court, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Patignan lang po muna.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ang date po ba niyan ay December 3, 2021?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: That is correct, sir.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yes. I confirm po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes. Now, puntahan po natin Under the label details, sir, may checkmark d'yon po sa box na quote-unquote plant visit. Ano pong ibig sabihin nito, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Binisita po rin nila yung planta. Kaya lang po dahil pandemic noon, on-site po ang pag-visit. Sorry, sorry. Virtual po ang naging pag-bisita po.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Nagkaroon ng... Hindi ko alam kung Zoom ang ginamit o Teams na meeting tapos pinakita doon sa ating mga taga BOI yun pong facilities.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes. And sir, how is this site visit important sir in respect to an application for a BOI certificate of registration?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Para po ma-establish na merong facility.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Next sir, let's go to the label under highlights of the activity of the same document. It states there, during the conduct of the virtual plant visit via Google Meet, it was verified that the proposed project, export producer of banana, may qualify under underlined new activity based on the following findings below. First, the company's building is still under construction, around 90% completed. Second, some of the listed equipment, sorting table, sieving machine, metal detector, slicing machine, genset are still for acquisition. There were no raw materials, e.g., cardava banana, carton boxes, packaging material seen during the inspection.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, what makes me curious is how do you reconcile Those findings during the site inspection and the eventual issuance of a certificate of registration number 2021-186 on December 9, 2021 by the BOI in favor of CALE88. Kasi parang dyan sir, may kulang sir.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Pag tinanggap po nila yung terms and conditions, ibig sabihin po, sinasabi po nila, okay, sinasabi lang po namin, registered ka. Pero bago ka makakuha ng incentives mo, sorry, maalala niyo po may start of commercial operation ka. Yun pong incentive mo, papakinabangan mo lang po pag nag start of commercial operation ka na po. So bago po siya mag start of commercial operation and makinabang siya dun sa mga incentive, kailangan po nakaayos na po itong mga ito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: On page 2 of that same document, sir. It also states under subtitle C, start of commercial operation, the firm proposes to commence its commercial operation on December 2021, original target. However, due to COVID-19 pandemic, the construction of the building was delayed and the movement of people, construction workers, was hampered. The BOI Davao team advised the firm relative to the assessment of the building to move the start of commercial operation to a later date. e.g. January 2022 to give ample time for completion of the building and installation. Ano po ang ibig sabihin ng part na ito ng report, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ibig sabihin lang po na na-move po yung start, yung kanyang target ng start of commercial operation but eventually po ang naging start ng commercial operation niya is 2023, January 2020. Pinapayagan naman po yun eh because you have three years from date of registration for you to have your SEO.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. Now, on the last page of this external contact report plant visit on December 3, 2021, we request the tech to flash the photos. There appears to be photos of a Google meeting. Can we zoom in on the people? And that first. What is this? What is the relevance of this? screenshot or photo documentation in relation to the inspection sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Pinapakita lang po niya na nagkaroon talaga po sila ng inspection meeting although virtual. Tapos sinasubmit din po ito doon sa Manila office sa amin po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At kung alam niyo lang po sir, On the bottom left portion of that Google Meet, there appears a person wearing a green polo with having a floral pattern. Do you know this? Who is this person if you know, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi ko siya personally kilala pero tinanong ko yung ating mga taga-Davao na officials kung sino po siya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And sino po according to your Davao officials, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Sabi po nila siya po si Doktora Lebosada.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Now, we ask the tech to scroll down to the other photos. Now, as you can see displayed on the screen, sir, there appears to be structures or photos of structures attached to your inspection report. Can we also see the other photos for the consumption of the public and our senator judges? What are these photos for, sir, in relation to the inspection conducted by the Board of Investments?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito po yung mga pinadalang litrato ng CALE88 na ito po yung tinatayo nilang facility para dun sa project.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And when you say facility and project, sir, can we be specific? What does that mean, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito po yung for the manufacture of banana chips for export purposes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At yung mga structure, mga planta ba yan, sir? Can we please be clarified on what those photos pertain to?

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Speculative. The witness would not be competent to identify what these photos are.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, these photos are submitted to their office, Your Honor. And they stipulated on these documents.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: It would be hearsay, Your Honor. He wasn't part of the people who made this virtual inspection.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Court will allow it as part of the official records submitted to his office.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Sir, if you could explain these photos, sir, what these structures are.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Sa sinabi po ng ating Davao office, ito po yung landing area. May kita niyo po kung saan i-receive yung mga raw materials. Pagkatapos po, ito po puro external structure po itong napakita rito. Pero sinasabi po na yung nasa loob yun po yung merong facilities, yung mga lutuan para doon sa mag-manufacture ng banana chips. Based on representation po sa amin nung Davao office po namin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sorry for interrupting sir and maraming salamat. Next naman sir, one of the documents that you submitted is also CALE88 Food Corporation's report on actual date of start of commercial operations, initial investment, and employment. Can you please explain what this document is about sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito po yung requirement ng BOI. na i-submit po nila isang notarized document para ma-trigger po sa amin na oh nag-i-start na itong project na ito ng commercial operation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And why does the Board of Investments have this document on file on its record, sir? What is the importance of this document?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Para ko alam namin yung reckoning date kung saan po siya nag-start ng commercial operation for purposes. of monitoring ng eligibility niya dun sa kanyang mga incentives.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. And as appearing on that document, sir, what is the actual start of commercial operations?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: January 1, 2023.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And under the subparagraph on employment, can we please focus it on the tech booth as well? Can you please tell us the number of labor at the actual start of operations as reported in that notarized? Report, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: 117 po yung sa direct labor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And ilan po ang administrative in sales na nalatay ko?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Isa po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, on the right side, on the rightmost column, it states payroll. What is that? What does that pertain to, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito po yung sweldo ng mga naka-indicate po na number ng mga tao na nandun po sa middle column.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. Now, one of the documents that you submitted as well to this impeachment court is CALE88 Foods Corporation's Board of Investment Form S-1 or the Annual Report on Actual Operations for the year 2023. Before we go into that document, sir, can you please tell us more about what the Board of Investment Form S-1 is?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito po yung isang importanteng dokumento po dahil ito yung nirequire po natin sa mga registered business enterprises to submit to us na notarized para namomonitor po natin yung compliance din nila doon sa kanilang mga pinangako at tinanggap na specific terms and conditions.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And what information is contained in that BOI form S-1, if any, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Meron po dito, siyempre po, yung basic information about the project. Tapos po, yung mga equity profile, yung gross income niya po for the year. Ito po kasi sinasubmit ito dapat bago mag April 30 of the succeeding year. Kasi po,

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Nakatapat din po yun dun sa pag-file niya po ng income tax return po niya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Maraming salamat, sir. Puntaan po natin yung BOI Form S-1 for the year 2023, sir. We request the tech as well. Specifically on page 4 thereof, sir. My question is, if you could see it, sir, under the table labeled as labor generation, Specifically on the aggregate number of employees, how many are the aggregate number of administrative slash sales employees of CALE88 Foods Corporation as reported in the year 2023 sir? Can we request the tech booth to zoom the numbers?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Page 4 po ba yung... ito. The number

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: The number of administrative and sales employees, sir, as indicated in that report?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Four po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: How about the direct labor, sir? How many?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. And again, sir, ano po yung annual payroll expense of the aggregate number of employees? What does that column mean?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito po yung sweldo ng mga empleyado po na inindicate nila.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And this is notarized and submitted with the Board of Investments, sir. Tama po ba? Just clarification. Now, let's go to page number 5 of the same document, sir. Sir, sabihin nyo lang po if kailangan nyo ng breaks. Kasi nakita ko yung mata nyo na. You're okay, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yes, yes. Malabo lang ang mata ko.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: On page 5, sir, under the table, performance data. Ano po yung meaning ng table na yan, sir? Yung performance data.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito po yung sinasabi nila sa atin kung ano yung kanilang production, sales, tapos naka-disaggregate between domestic sales at saka export sales. Importante din sa atin yung export sales kasi yun yung makikita natin kung compliance sila dun sa 70-30 requirement po natin na ratio.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay sir. Let's go first to may nakalagay kasi total production value. and then unit measurement. What does this refer to, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yung total production, yung na-produce niya ho na banana chips.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, next, sir, on the same table, if you can look at below that total production, it also states export sales. Now, there is an indication, volume of export sales. What does that mean, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito po yung quantity as expressed dito po in kilograms.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And according to this report made by CALE88 Foods Corporation, what is the volume of export sales in the year 2023 of banana chips, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: 216,000 kilograms po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, below that number is value. What is that number? What does that number pertain to, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yun pong revenue niya dahil naibenta niya po sa labas dahil export po ito yung 216,000 kilograms na yan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Sir, you also submitted other BOI form S-1 for the subsequent years, sir. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Now... I will no longer belabor the other forms but my only question sir is if you look at the BOI form S-1 for the year 2025, it appears to be different than those in the prior years 2023 and 2024. Can you please explain to us sir why there is a difference between those forms?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Nag-iba na po kami ng form kasi between those years.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So nothing is wrong with that change sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ano po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Wala namang pong mali dyan. Just to confirm.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Wala po. Wala.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Now, next sir, you also submitted audited financial statements of CALE88 Foods Corporation specifically for the years 2023, 2024, and 2025. How is this related or relevant to the earlier BOI Form S-1 that were submitted by CALE88 Foods Corporation? If at all, sir.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Submitted din po ito sa amin ng CALE88. Part 2 ng requirements namin for monitoring, kailangan nila mag-submit ng S-1 at saka ng audited financial statements po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And what is the reason that they need to submit that together with the S-1, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Binabangga din po natin yung mga numero na nakikita po natin doon sa S-1 po nila, doon sa kanila, audited financial statements, kung nagtutugma po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, thank you, sir. Next, you also submitted as part of the documents that you submitted to the impeachment court, CALE88 Foods Corporations VAT zero rate certification dated May 2, 2024 and another one VAT zero rate certification dated April 10, 2026. At meron po itong mga supporting documents. Do you have those documents with you now, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, unahin po natin yung na unang zero VAT certification dated May 2, 2024.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sir, can you please tell us who issues this VAT zero rate certification in the first place, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yun pong ating Executive Director sa BOI in charge of management services.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Dahil... Under din po ng kanyang management services yung ating mga legal service at yung ating incentives and compliance division po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And kanino pong VAT zero rate certification yan based on the document sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Para po kay CALE88.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now at the bottom of that document sir, can we scroll down? There's a signature above the printed name, Atty. Bobby G. Fondevilla. Again, sir, can we clarify? Fondevilla. Can you please tell us what his position is and what his authority is to sign that?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: At that time po siya po yung Executive Director ng Management Services.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, on the right side, sir, there also appears a QR code. What is the purpose of that QR code, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Para pag po binaril po ito, ilalabas din niyo po niya yung BOI VAT Certificate na ito po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. We now have seen that in the year 2024, there's actually a VAT zero rate certification. What is the purpose of this VAT zero rate certification in relation to CALE88, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Para po ito yung papakita ni CALE88 dun sa kanyang mga suppliers na inindicate din po niya sa kanyang VAT zero rating application form para po hindi siya singilin ng VAT nung suppliers na yun.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Again sir, why is it important that our enterprises are given this incentive sir? Para lang po malaman natin.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Para po hindi siya sisingilin ng 12% VAT, hindi ipapasa sa CALE88. So mas makakatipid po siya nung pag bumili po siya nung in this particular case po ay gagamitin niya po ito for

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: oil, coconut oil, carton boxes, tsaka plastics na kanyang mga bibilin po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. And sir, what are the requirements for the Board of Investments to issue that VAT zero rate certification in general, sir? And if you know.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Pwede akong tumingin sa dokumento ko.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ano po, nung time na nag-apply po siya nito, nung 2024, duly accomplished application form, notarized affidavit signed by the firm's authorized representative, enumerating the documents submitted to BOI, duly notarized sales performance report for the year.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: For the year immediately preceding the period to be covered by the certification. Ibig sabihin po kung 2024 po ito, yung pong kanyang mga sales performance is for 2023. Duly notarized detailed export sales report and annual production for the year. immediately preceding the period to be covered by the certification. Original and notarized bank certifications explicitly indicating inward remittances due to export proceeds. Copy of annual report of operations, yung S1 po natin. Latest audited financial statement.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Barangay and Unaudited income statement for the year preceding the period to be covered by the certification. Barangay certification indicating that the firm is existing and operating. Mayor's permit, business permit. Pictures of the production area and signage of plant factory. Copy of BOI certificate of registration with specific terms and conditions. Copy of sworn declaration affidavits per BIR template. Pero in-streamline na natin ito rin noong 2026.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay, sir. Now, after CALE88, Foods Corporation submitted its requirements. What process does the Board of Investment do prior to granting? What is the assessment that it makes essentially?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Una, tinitignan niya kung na-submit itong mga ito. Tapos pangalawa, importante lang din ito kasi titignan niya kung na-meet niya po yung 70-30 na export sales requirement. Dabangga din niya yung bank certificate na nagpapatunay na may mga inward remittances siya galing sa kanyang mga Buyers from abroad.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So, this is confirmatory, sir. Talagang ina-assess at kinuscrutinize ng board investments yung application. Thank you, sir. Let's go to Annex A of that VAT 0 certification, sir. It's one of the documents you attached. I think that would be the document after that certification. Ano po itong dokumento na ito, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Nire-refer lang ko nito, naka-attach ko ito dun sa certification. Mas detalyade lang ko ito, sinasabi niya kung ano yung registered activity, tapos ano yung tax incentive entitlement niya, tapos ano yung performance conditions, tapos saan mga goods niya pwedeng ibangga ito, yung attributable goods and services.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you sir.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Na nakalagay po dito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Pasensya sir. Thank you sir. Sinabi niyo po naka-attach. Sino pong nag-prepare ng dokumento na yan?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ang BOI po yung nag-prepare nito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Sir, let's go still to that document. If you look at the lower right portion, if my memory serves me right, sinabi po yan terms and conditions. Tapos, can we please zoom in on that portion?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: That would be on the fifth or fourth column. Thank you. Now, in the terms of conditions, on the right column, it says status remarks compliant. What does that mean in relation to CALE88 Foods Corporation?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Na-complied po siya dito sa mga terms and conditions ng kanyang registration. Performance commitment.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay, yung performance commitment tapos merong 70%, what does that... Part of the table means, sir. Can you please explain?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ibig sabihin po yung kanyang benta sa export is within 70% ng kanyang total sales. Nakocomply niya po yun.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And the Board of Investments kinoconfirm yung export, sir.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Basit po dun sa mga sinabit niya sa aming mga dokumento.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, below that, it's regulatory compliance and it states complied.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: General term kasi sir. Sorry. Yung performance commitment po pala, ang tingin ko ito yung sa employment. Kasi may nakaseparate na export ratio tayong nakalagay sa...

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay sir. In the regulatory compliance, it says complied. What does that mean sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: So ibig sabihin po, nagsubmit siya sa amin yung S1.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now what... Now, sinabi niyo po may mga pruweba. Now, one of the documents I noticed in the documents in relation to VAT zero certification are bank statements. Tama po ba, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Tama.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: What is the relevance of these bank statements from CALE88 Foods Corporation in relation to its application for a VAT zero rate certification? May we request that that bank statement be flashed?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Ano po ang relevance niyan sa application? Why is it important?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Para mapatunayan namin na meron siyang pumapasok na foreign exchange na galing sa labas. Dahil kasi kung mag-iexport siya, normally yung bayad is foreign exchange tapos pumapasok sa banko. So pinapatunayan lang po nito na may pumasok po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, in relation to those as well, there are affidavits. May we request the tech to refer to those affidavits.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sino po ang mga nakapirma ng mga affidavit in relation to the VAT zero rate certification dated May 2, 2024 issued by the Board of Investments?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yung nakapirma po si Dr. Lourdes Lebosada.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And ano po ang date ng notarization ng sworn affidavit na yan?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: March 8, 2024 po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And ano po ang relasyon ng sworn affidavit na yan sa application for zero-rate certification?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Kailangan po ito para dun sa ano? Kailangan niya pong i-attach ito dun sa kanyang application form.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, meron din po kayong sinubmit na CALE88 Foods Corporation VAT zero-rate certification dated April 10, 2026 at may mga supporting documents. Now, again, just to confirm, sino yung nag-issue ng certificate na yan, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Dito po si Executive Director Fe Del Rosario.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At sino po si Executive Director Fe Del Rosario po?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Siya na po yung Executive Director ng Management Services ng BOI. Okay. Nung in-issue po ito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, sinabi nyo na po kanina na one of the documents that you need to submit, To be entitled to a VAT zero rate certificate are affidavits sir. Tama po ba? At ano po itong mga affidavits na to nga sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Itong dito po yung affidavit po na nagsasabi na limbawa po dito po sa for this particular can I read na lang po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes sir please.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: For this particular 2020-2026 submission Afidavit po ito ni Salvador Leo Sacurom na sinasabi na siya yung current na accounting and compliance officer ng CALE88 that inauthorize siya ng mga board of directors to transact business with us na siya po yung authorized representative ng CALE88 for their application for VAT zero rating. Tapos na siya rin po yung nag-prepare at nag-submit ng mga forms that we were requiring for this VAT zero rating application.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. Now, we don't need to flash these documents for the 2026 with respect to the banks to protect the privacy. But my question, sir, if you look at the documents you submitted, in the certificate of inward remittance, Meron pong mga remitter dyan na naka-indicate. Do you see that, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Apo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, marami po kasing Zhengzhou Food Call Limited. What is the reason why these remittances should be reported, sir, in relation to VAT zero certification?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Para ma-identify lang po kung sino yung mga nag-re-remit ng mga customer po niyan. Pinagbentahan po ng kumpanya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, meron pa rin... We don't need to flash this, but there's also a certificate of inward remittance from security bank. Meron ding mga what appears to be Chinese corporations. What is the importance of CALE88 Foods Corporation submitting these inward remittances to the Board of Investments?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Again po, para mapatunayan po namin na may pumapasok sa kanya na export revenues. Hindi po namin nire-require kung galing sa ang bansa.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. Now, another document submitted is also CALE88 Foods Corporation's Detailed Export Sales and Annual Production Report. Do you have that, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Baka after na nito. Mas detailed ito. Ito ba yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Opo, yes. Now, I've actually reviewed that document, sir. And very many product exports were done to Chinese companies or to China. With corresponding sales volume and sales value. What is the relevance of that document in relation to an application for VAT zero rate certifications?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: So, para ma-establish lang po na meron siyang export sales.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, sinabi niyo po kanina sir, before a VAT zero rate certification is issued na na-issue naman po ng BOI, nag-a-assess po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: What

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: irregularities, if any, did the BOI find in relation to those China-related transactions or exports, if at all?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ang pinaka tinitignan lang po namin dito ay kung pasok po siya dun sa 70% na export na requirement po niya. Sinisigurado lang namin na yung exports niya hindi bababa sa 70%.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So to confirm sir, the BOI found no issue in exportations relation to China.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: On the export requirement po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you sir. Now, one of the documents that you also submitted is CALE88 Foods Corporation's letter dated April 29, 2026. May we just request the tech to flash that document?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Do you have it with you sir? Now, can you please explain to us what the purpose of this letter request is as it is addressed to Attorney Elyjean DC Portoza, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Opo, eto po ay nagre-request po si CALE88 ng Certification of Good Standing dahil po si CALE88 ay Nagpapa rin yun yung kanyang accreditation dun sa parang client profile system ng Bureau of Customs para ho tuloy-tuloy ho yung kanyang capability to import and export. Requirement po kasi yun ng Bureau of Customs na may certificate of good standing po siya galing sa amin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. Now, naka-address po yung letter ng CALE88 Foods Corporation dated April 29, 2026 kay Atty. Elyjean DC Portoza. Sino po itong si Atty. Elyjean DC Portoza? Can you please explain why the letter had to be addressed to her?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Siya po yung director ng aming legal and compliance services. So sila po yung mga nagmo-monitor ng standing po ng mga registered business enterprises.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Now, alam natin sir na ito po yung letter na ipinadala ni CALE88 Foods Corporation sa Board of Investments. Can you please tell us what a certificate of good standing or endorsement of good standing means, sir?

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Your Honor, I'd have to object to this line of questioning on the ground of relevance. In the first place, Your Honor, this document already pertains to April 29, 2026. which is outside the period covered by the charges in the articles. It doesn't even pertain to taxable year 2025. It pertains to 2026, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: We note the manifestation of Attorney Erwin. May we proceed, Attorney Justin? Thank

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: you, Your Honor. Ulitin ko po, sir, ano po yung meaning ng Certificate of Good Standing or what does that mean when the Board of Investment issues such certificate?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: That it is compliant with the specific terms and conditions at saka po dun sa mga hinihingi po nating reports from the company.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And tanong lang po, would the Board of Investments issue a certificate of good standing to an implausible business model, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ano pong ibig sabihin ng... In the context nung sinabi niyo po ng implausible business model.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Just as it is, sir. As you understand the term that I just said, sir.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Sa pagkakaintindi ko lang po dito, inisuan po siya on the basis nung kanyang commitments po sa amin. As to whether that is referring to implausible or not implausible, I apologize. Hindi ko masasagot.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. Let's move on sir. One of the documents that you submitted as well is a Board of Investments Travel Order No. 2026-168 dated April 28, 2026. Can you please explain to us sir what the relevance of this document is and why you submitted this to the court?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Opo, kasi po in connection dun po sa request po ng kumpanya for Certificate of Good Standing, binisita rin po siya Nung aming legal and compliance service. So pinuntahan niya po yung firm na ito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now what is the importance of visiting the firm sir in relation to that?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Opo. Para po makita talaga kung ano yung estado tapos matanong din po siya. Lalo na po dito dahil po nung nagdo-documentary check po tayo nakita po natin na bumaba yung employment na nireport po niya. Dun sa ating S-1 from I think 200 noong previous year. Mga nasa 200 po siya noong 2024 po yata eh. Tapos bumaba po to 50 or 51 the following year. So gusto lang po makita talaga ng ating mga compliance officers at matanong kung bakit po bumaba.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Sa B.O.I. travel...

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you sir. Sa BOI travel order naman sir, it states that sa purpose of travel, it states the travel for the purpose of the verification of status and operations. How is this related to the one that you explained sir to confirm the operations of the business?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Para makita po nila yung actual na estado, makausap yung mga tao po na involved.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Bakit kailangan ng travel orders yung mga tauhan ng ating board of investment?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Kasi po galing po sila sa Manila at pupunta po sila. May mga galing po dito sa Manila.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So, okay. Next, sir. Let's go to the next document. You also submitted to this impeachment court a board of investment report on site inspection dated May 18, 2026, sir. Do you confirm submitting that document, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yes, po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now... What is this plant inspection report, sir? Can you please elaborate to us what this document is?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito po yung in relation po dun sa travel order. So, binisita na po nila tapos po ito po yung report nung naging pagbisita po nila.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, on the document, it states under attendees to the plant inspection, quote-unquote, BOILCS. What does that mean, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Legal and Compliance Service po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, meron pong mga pangalan under that table. Si Atty. Elyjean DC Portoza and etc. Sino po ito, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Siya po yung Director ng Legal and Compliance Service.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At bakit po nakalagay yung pangalan niya sa report na yan?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Siya po yung pumunta dun sa kasama niya po yung dalawa pang tao.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, sa baba na table, sir, meron ding nakalabel na CFC. Ano pong ibig sabihin yan, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: CALE88 Foods Corporation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. At sino naman po ang mga pangalan na nakalagay sa baba, sir? Sino po sila?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito na po yung mga bagong may-ari, bagong presidente nung CALE88 Foods Corporation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sorry, sir. Pakuulit po yung sinabi nyo. Sino po ito sila? Sorry.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Siya po niyang, ito pong si Lolita Paimalan, Chris Chu. Tsaka si Leo Sacurom. Ito na po yung mga bagong mga opisyalis ng CALE88 na okay lang ho ba. Nung pagpunta ko kasi natin doon, doon po natin alaman din na nagbago na pala ng may-ari po yung CALE88.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito na po yung mga bagong yun. Kaya po sinabihan din natin sila na oh kung nagbago kayo ng may-ari, kayo na pala. Meron kaming requirement din po na kailangan i-inform niyo ang BOI ng change in beneficial ownership. So may mga form din po ron, may proseso din po para ma-reflect din po natin sa records natin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sir, balikan lang natin yung naunang table which is under BOI-LCS. In number two, who is Ms. Lorna D. Garcia, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Taga Manila po namin ito na isa sa mga specialist po natin sa BOI.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And what is her designation sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Senior investment specialist po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And what is the importance of a senior investment specialist attending in that plant inspection sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Siya rin po yung nakakaalam ng proyekto. Familiar po siya dun sa mga dokumento po in addition dun po sa ating Davao.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: BOI Extension Office. And

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: what is her division, sir, as stated in that document?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Division B, Compliance Division B.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Next, sir, it also states a Ms. Marian Gay U. Liwanag. Who is this person, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Isa din po siyang empleyado ng BOI under the Legal and Compliance Service Division.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And from what office of the Board of Investment, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yun po. Compliance Service Division po. Compliance Division.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And where is that office located, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Sa Manila po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. And what is her... It states there investment specialist, sir. What is the importance of an investment specialist in a plant inspection, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ganon din po. Meron po siyang kaalaman doon sa mga requirements ni BOI at saka po, yun, sa mga requirements ni BOI.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now... Balikan natin si Atty. Elyjean DC Portoza. Sir, sinabi niyo po, Director of Legal and Compliance. Where is her office, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Sa Manila po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. So, just to emphasize and conclude on this point, ang lahat na nag-inspect, taga-Maynila po?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Taga-Mainila.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Thank you, sir.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Pwede po ba ako magtanong din kung may nakasamang taga-BIO sa aking mga kasamahan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, I think.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: No need, Dr. Perry. The question was with respect to only the three people mentioned in the document. Salamat po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Let's go to item number two of that same report, sir. Can you please read to us the finding under number 1, sir? As stated in the document. Can you please read it out loud, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: During the inspection, the firm's compliance with its terms and conditions has been discussed, particularly its direct labor commitment. For 2025, which is year 3, the firm had to maintain direct labor of 39. Yun po kasi yung nakalagay dun sa kanyang specific terms and conditions na kinomit po sa atin sa gobyerno.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: So, but based on the 2025 BOI Form S-1, the firm had an actual labor of 50 while in 2024, they had reported 201. In response to the inquiry on the reduction of the number of labor from 2024 to 2025, the firm explained that it was attributable to a period of non-operation in 2025 due to the change in management and ownership.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: What was the response of the Board of Investment as stated on the paragraph after that, sir? Can you please read it out loud?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ang sinabi po namin, noting the change in ownership, the LCS advised the firm to submit a request letter for said change, stating the reason therefore, Presenting the previous and current ownership structures and attaching relevant documents including the general information sheets before and after the change.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Now sir, sinabi niyo po na may inspection and na-discuss po ang mga employee. What is the participation of the Board of Investments in respect to the assessment of the employees on the ground, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: We rely po on the S-1 submission.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, in the ground inspection, sir, what do you find or what do you assess, sir, on the ground in the location itself of the project?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Biasi po dun sa report, tinitignan din po nila kung ano yung, kung nag-ooperate po ba. Hindi ko lang alam kung talagang binilang nila isa-isa na may 50 ngang tao na nandun.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Let's go to the finding number 3, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Can you please discuss that, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Finally, the LCS has reminded the firm on the timely submission of its annual reports, BOI Form S1, the annual financial statements, income tax return.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Otherwise, it would incur penalty. The LCS also advised the firm to use the new BOI Form S1. which may be downloaded from the BOI website.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: What is the importance of that finding in the inspection?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Kasi po, kumisang nauhuli daw siya sa mga pag-submit niya ng mga report. Kaya kailangan natin silang i-remind na mag-submit ka on time.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Last on this document, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At the last page of that document, there appears to be photographs as well. Can we please zoom in? We ask that the... Tech display, a clearer picture of that. What are these photos, sir, if you know?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito po yung documentation na po na kinunan nung ating team nung bumisita po sila doon sa production facility ng CALE88.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And to clarify, sir, it's the Board of Investments team who took these photos, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi ko alam kung kanino camera pero ang nag-attach po nito dito sa report ay yung team po namin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And what, can you please tell us what is this, what is shown in those photos?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: I can only interpret based on what I see din po. Pero yan po, nakikita na meron po silang operation, tapos naka, this is a food company, naka, tawag doon, siguro parang gowns sila to ensure the Cleanliness. Tapos may nakita silang mga inventaryo dito po sa kumpanya. Mga saging.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Tsaka may mga ongoing production po.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Pero sir, ito under new management na itong sinasabi ko.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, may I just respectfully inquire if we still have time, Your Honor? I still have a few five pages in my direct examination, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Would this be a good time to pause, Attorney Justin? Or you want to consume the remaining four minutes?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: I prefer that we pause for the meantime, Your Honor, with the court's indulgence.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay. And you need approximately less than an hour when you resume?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay. We shall pause for lunch.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Trial will resume at 1 p.m.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Trial is in recess.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Justin, you may proceed with your direct examination of the witness, Dr. Perry.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Before I proceed with my, continue with my direct examination, Your Honor, just a manifestation from the defense, Your Honor. There were changes in the markings with respect to prior markings such that the markings that were made during the marking sessions beyond the trial were different from those manifested. During the trial itself, Your Honor, we just request, Your Honor, that the markings done before the Clerk of Court be adopted, Your Honor. Just for the record, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Duly noted.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Continuing with my direct examination.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, Sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Magandang hapon po. Good afternoon, Sir. Sir, let's go to one of the documents that you submitted before this impeachment court. That would be the endorsement of good standing. From the Board of Investments to the Bureau of Customs, sir. Do you have that document, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Apo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, sir. Now, can you please tell us what this letter is all about, sir? Specifically, why the Board of Investments needed to send this letter to the Bureau of Customs in relation, of course, to CALE88 Foods Corporation?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Nag-request po si CALE88 nitong certification na to para makapag-register siya dun sa client profile registration system ng Bureau of Customs. Tapos po tinignan natin yung kanyang record kaya po ang sinabi natin dito the firm is compliant with the terms and conditions of its registration kaya hence it is of good standing.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay, thank you sir. Now my question sir is

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Excuse me. Why did the Board of Investment send it directly to the Bureau of Customs, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ganon po talaga yung proseso po natin na kailangan sila yung sa kanila po ipadala.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Can we please go to the bottom portion of that, the same letter, please?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Letter, sir. It appears to be signed by Atty. Elyjean DC Portoza, sir. How is that person related to the person who conducted the site inspection in CALE88 Foods Corporation, sir, in Tagum, Davao?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Siya din po ang nag-site inspection. Pero hindi naman po talaga kailangan na siya rin yung nagkataon lang po ito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now sir, if you recall, there were findings in the BOI site inspection, yung mga diniscuss po natin. And that report was dated May 18, 2026. We also have now an endorsement of good standing dated June 16, 2026. How do you reconcile the issuance of both documents, sir? On one hand, we have a BOI site inspection report. Making findings in relation to CALE88 Foods Corporation's operation and on the other.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Nonetheless, the BOI issued an endorsement of good standing dated June 16, 2026.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Consistent pa rin naman po dahil ang tinignan po natin dito ay yung mga nakalagay sa specific terms and conditions. Number one po halimbawa yung kanyang Labor na sinasabi. Tapos po nakita naman po natin base dun sa S-1 niya. Ang pagpunta po dun, ito pong Certificate of Good Standing, hindi lang po ito base dun sa actual inspection. Kasama din po dito yung pag-review ng kanyang mga documentary requirements at saka yung pong nilagay niyang mga information dun. Nakita naman po natin na compliant pa rin po siya base po dun sa mga sinubmit po niya. Kaya po nag-issue tayo nitong Certificate of Good Standing.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. One of the documents you also submitted before this impeachment court is a Certificate of Income Tax Holiday Incentive or CETI dated April 22, 2026. Do you have it with you now, sir? April 22, 2025, rather.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Certificate of Entitlement to Tax Incentives.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Can you please tell us sir for the record when this was issued?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: It was issued on April 22, 2025.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And who issued that Certificate of Income Tax Holiday Incentives sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Si Director Elyjean Portoza po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And what is his or her authority to issue said certificate sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: As the director of the legal and compliance service.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: May we also request that it be flashed on the screen? Now my question sir, can you please explain to us what this document or what the purpose of this document is?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Pagka po kasi magfafile ng income tax return ang isang registered business enterprise, sinasama niya po ito. Naka-attach po ito dun sa ITR. Kasi po di ba pag nag-submit kayo ng income tax return sa BIR, dapat dun meron na nakalagay na nagbayad kayo. Tapos may bank receipt na nagbayad kayo. So in lieu of that po, ito yung ilalagay niya. Para ma-indicate na hindi pa ako nagbayad kasi entitled ako to tax incentives. Tapos magko-compute po ngayon sila. Babalik ko yun sa amin tapos mag-i-issue po kami ng another endorsement naman of the tax incentives na i-dedicate naman po nila doon sa kanilang isasubmit sa BIR.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And this is confirmatory sir. Evidensya lang po ito para to prove na hindi po kailangan magbayad ng tax yung kumpanya. And in this case, CALE88 Foods Corporation.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Pero ito, ano lang ito, certification. Hindi pa ito'y nakalagay kung magkano yung kanyang hindi dapat bayaran. May isang proseso pa po doon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, one of the documents that you submitted earlier is the certificate of registration, di ba? Natalakay na po natin. Ano ang relasyon dyan ng certificate of registration? Enterprise Number 2021-1-86 at nung Certificate of Income Tax Holiday Incentive dated April 22, 2025 na tinalakay lang po natin. What is the relationship of these two documents?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito po yung nag-ooperationalize nung sa Certificate of Registration po naka-enumerate doon yung mga incentives na available para sa kanya. Yung letter A po ay income tax holiday for 6 years. So ito po sinasabi lang na oh, itong kumpanya to ay registered sa amin tapos entitled siya to tax incentives.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, another set of documents that the Board of Investments submitted to this impeachment court is a letter request for change in ownership dated July 8, 2026. We request that it be flashed with attachments. of CALE88 Foods Corporation's General Information Sheet in the year 2024 and CALE88 Foods Corporation's General Information Sheet in the year 2025. Can we just zoom in please on the portions? Sir, if you know what is this letter all about sir, can you please tell us?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Kung maalala niyo po doon po sa site inspection report, nalaman din po ng BOI na iba na ho yung may-ari ng CALE88. Kaya po pinayuhan natin sila na you are required to submit the new ownership to BOI.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes sir. So in short sir, what is the relationship of this letter to the earlier Board of Investment Report on Site Inspection dated May 18, 2026. To be specific, sir.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito po yung sagot nila doon sa ating pagpayo sa kanila, meaning si CALE88, na kailangan ninyong i-reflect sa records na amin na kayo na yung bagong owners ng CALE88.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And what is the relevance in the submission that you made before this impeachment, sir? There are attachments which are the 2024 General Information Sheet. and 2025 General Information Sheet of CALE88 Foods Corporation. What is the relevance of those SEC documents in relation to this letter request for change in ownership dated July 8, 2026, if any, sir? Yun

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: po ay yung sa GIS po, eto yung mga nagre-reflect naman nung nasa SEC ay na-transfer na po, na-reflect na po dun sa kanyang incorporation na Sila na po yung bagong owners. So, iyon po yung patunay na kailangan nilang i-attach dun sa letter nila para iyon po yung pagbasehan namin na iba na nga yung may-ari nitong CALE88.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And can we please go to the signature page of that letter? And in the document that you have with you now, sir, and that appearing on screen, who is the person who signed the letter on behalf of CALE88 Foods Corporation, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Dito po kung titignan po natin doon sa capital structure annex B naka-attach po dito sa letter din nila ng July 8. Ito pong si Lolita Paimalan. Sana po yung nakalagay na may ownership ng 5% CALE88. Tapos tignan ko lang ako ng reflect dun sa GIS. Alam ko siya na yung presidente ng CALE88.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And before siya sir, sino po ang base sa mga documents na sinumiti ng CALE88 Foods Corporation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Particularly in the year 2024.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: I-check ko lang ko kung si Manases Carpio o kung si Lourdes Lemusada.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes sir. Please do sir.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Sa GIS po ay si, ng 2024 ay si Manases R. Carpio yung presidente po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At sino po ba ang iba na mga officers ng kumpanya?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Si Lourdes Lebosada po ang tumatay yung treasurer. Tapos si Myrie Ellenniel Leaño ang corporate secretary po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Puntahan po natin yung stock holdings. Ano po yung stock holdings dyan sir sa 2024?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Sa stock holdings niya po si Manases R. Carpio ay may ownership na 47.5%. Si Lourdes Lebosada 47.5% at si Myrie Leaño ay 5%.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Ulitin ko lang sir for clarification. Anong taon po yung kakasabi nyo lang?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Dito po ay 2024 na GIS. Saglit lang po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Puntaan po natin yung 2025 sir. Sino po yung stockholders ng CALE88 Foods Corporation sa 2025 general information sheet na isinumite ng kumpanya sa Board of Investments?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito na po si Ian C. Neo, COS.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Tapos po Lolita Paimalan, President-Treasurer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay po. Punta natin yung stockholding sir. Ano po yung stockholding sa taon na yan? Yung 2025 general information.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Si Lolita Paimalan po ay 5%. Tapos po si... Piki mong Philippines ay 95%.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay, sir. And again, sir, para lang for the record, bakit po kailangan mag-send ng letter na ito sa Board of Investments?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Talaga pong nire-require namin para malaman namin kung sino yung beneficial ownership. Although, mas importante ito dun sa mga sectors na merong Restriction sa foreign equity. Kaya mas kailangan namin yan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At dito naman po sir, kung alam niyo po sa Export Enterprise na in-issue ng BOI sa CALE, 88 Foods Corporation, meron po bang restrictions on foreign equity?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Wala po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now,

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: in the letter that you submitted to this impeachment court dated November 18, 2026, the last document is actually A letter of approval of the request for change of ownership dated October 29, 2026. You confirm that, sir? That is the last document indicated in that letter?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Oo po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And what is the relationship of this letter, sir, to the earlier request or letter sent by CALE88 Foods Corporation for change of ownership, if any, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito na po yung... nag... Approved. Teka lang. Evaluation. Noting. Noting the change in ownership undertaken by the following persons from Kila Carpio, Lebosada, and Leaño to Paimalan and Pikimong-Pikimong Corporation.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: So nasa records na po. Ninote na po natin at ito na po yung nasa records ni BOI ngayon na new owners nun po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, sir. Puntahan naman natin, sir, yung... Letter dated November 20, 2026 na you submitted to the impeachment court, sir. These are the new set of documents, sir. I just have a few questions in relation to these documents, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sir, bakit po ba na, ano po yung reason or what is the reason why you had to submit these additional documents, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito lang po yung mga supporting documents related dun sa Certificate of Registration nung una po silang nag-apply para po kumpleto. Ito po yung mga internal na documents na nasa amin po in relation doon sa approval ng application po nila tsaka pag-issue ng Certificate of Registration.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And this is just confirmatory sir. You're saying that ito po yung mga sinubmit nila sa application process nila to be issued the Certificate of Registration.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Would that be correct, sir?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi lang po. Kasi po, limbawa itong una, memo request for the printing of certificate of registration. Internal po ito sa amin. So, internal request po noong director na o i-print na tapos para mapirmahan na po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So, just in general, sir, please explain. Documents 1 to 18. What relation does this have to CALE88 Foods Corporation and its registration with the Board of Investments?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: So ito po yung mga dokumento na either in support po noon sa application ni CALE88. o kaya po kasama din po dito yung kanilang mga affidavit, kasama din po dito yung kanilang halimbawa dito at the very beginning kasi kailangan sabihin nila sa BOI kung ano yung pinipili nilang incentive. Halimbawa SCIT ba yan o enhanced deduction. May mga ganun kasi silang choices. So, ito yung mga dokumento na sinubmit nila in relation to their acceptance at saka pag-issue namin nung kanilang registration.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay, sir. Now, nag-aral po kasi ako tungkol sa BOI at sa structure ng ating government institution. I note that under Chapter 2, Article 7 of Executive Order 226, The Omnibus Investments Code of 1987, the Board of Investment has the following powers. Number 7, periodically check and verify the compliance by registered enterprises with the relevant provisions of this code, with the rules and regulations promulgated under this code, and with the terms and conditions of registration. The next power, or subparagraph 8, after due notice, the Board of Investment has the power to, after due notice, Cancel the registration or suspend the enjoyment of incentives, benefits of any registered enterprise, and or require refund of incentives enjoyed by such enterprise, including interest and monetary penalties for a. failure to maintain the qualifications required by this Code for registration with the Board and b. for violation of any provision of this Code of the Rules and Regulations issued under this Code. of the terms and conditions of registration or of loss for the protection of labor or the consuming public. There is a proviso after that. But I will not ask you about the provision of the law sir. My specific question to the Board of Investment is this. Given the several documents that were submitted by CALE88 Foods Corporation, the course of its application, registration, and even to this date 2026 or from 2021, to 2026. What cancellation of registration did the Board of Investments do to CALE88 Foods Corporation, if any?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Wala po kami on record na in-issue na about cancellation ng registration nila.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: How about the suspension of enjoyment of incentives? What suspension did the Board of Investments issue in relation to CALE88 Foods Corporation from 2021? It's start of operation January 1, 2023 to the present.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Wala po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: No further questions for direct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Erwin Cross?

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Good afternoon, Dr. Rodolfo.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Good afternoon po.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Perry na lang po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Perry,

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Balikan natin yung mga documents na...

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Sinubmit ninyo sa impeachment court. Unahin natin itong external contact report which is letter B dito sa transmittal letter dated November 18, 2026.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Confirm ko lang, nabanggit nyo na rin naman kanina na nakalagay dito sa external contact report ng inspection. Nung supposed plant or project site ng CALE88 ay virtual.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: At nangyari ito supposedly nung December 3, 2021.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: So ibig sabihin ko ng virtual, walang physical inspection ng mga tao. Hindi rin po kayo kasama?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi po ako kasama.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Hindi nakawakan ng BOI employees yung building, yung pader, hindi nila na-test yung floor?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
