turns.text: So nakalagay po dito sa letter, you can read it with me. Dear Dr. Lebosada, we are pleased to inform you that the Board, through the Board of Investments, Davao Extension Office, has approved your company's project on December 7, 2021. So this was a day after po nung... application form na December 6, 2021. So, when yung notice of, yung publication notice po, dated December 6. So, kung ako po, nag-oppose po ako by December 8, ano pong sasabihin ng BOI Davao sa akin na late na po ako dahil may lumalabas po na may approval na. Late po ba yung opposition ko? Am I on time or maaga pa po?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Para po kasi maging operational talaga yan, kailangan po siyang makareceive nung final approval from the board mismo. Yun po yung certificate of registration na tinatransmit po natin. So hindi pa po... Yun po, approved at the level ng ating BEO, yung Division Chief. Pero pagka po meron pang, ang importante po, hindi pa namin i-issue po yung Certificate of Registration po natin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: At kailangan po yun ng action ng Board of Investment mismo?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Una-una po, pagka po kasi ginawa yun ng Division Chief, ini- Kagaya po nasabi ko kanina, iniipon po lahat ng mga MSME application tapos sinasabay-sabay sila para inote ng board every first meeting of the month.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Do you remember po kung kailan yung first meeting of the month nung December 2021?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi ko na ako maalala eh.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Pwede ko pong tignan yung records po kung kailan siya.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Kasi pwede pong tumama yun ng ibang araw. Halimbawa walang quorum during the, naiiba-iba ho yung, although we try as much as possible na.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Pero na-notice ko po na December 9, meron na pong DOI na from ano.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Certificate of Registration.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: So, December 9, 2021 is Thursday po. December 9, 2021. Thursday po yun.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi ko po maalala.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Anyway, hindi pa rin po tapos yung 3-day period for the public to oppose. Kasi

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: December 6 po na-publish. 6 po ba nakalagay po yung naka-post? 6, 7, 8, 9 po nilabas.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: So for you po, kasama yung December 6 na?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Opo, kasama po. Binilang na po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Hindi nyo po alam kung anong oras pinublish ito?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi ko po alam.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Hindi nyo alam. So pwede yung late, hindi afternoon na?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi ko po alam.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Hindi nyo masabi. Anyway, just to ask, sino po yung mayor ng Davao City noong 2021? Alam nyo po ba?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi... Hindi ko po alam. Kung sino ang mayor ng Davao City noong 2021.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Okay. Kailangan po mag-submit ang registered business enterprises ng kanilang Articles of Incorporation sa BOI. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Kasama po dun sa... Opo. Kasama po. Na-incorporate na po siya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Ipakita ko po sa inyo yung Articles of Incorporation ng Cale88.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Ah, by the way, before this. Okay. Nabanggit niyo po yung board kanina. So minsan hindi natutuloy yung meeting ng board kasi walang quorum. 7 po ang members ng BOI. So ilan po dapat ang members para magka-quorum?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Majority lang po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: So dapat may 4 members na mag-attend para may quorum para mag-conduct ng business. Anong effect po pag walang quorum ang Board of Investments?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi po valid yung action ng board.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Hindi makaka-act at all ang BOI?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi po makaka-act.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: So at least four, okay. Pakitingnan po yung Articles of Incorporation ng Cale88.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Yung portion po na, yung number of Board of Directors, pakibasa po kung ilan ng Board of Directors dapat ng Cale88 Foods.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: That the number of directors of the corporation shall be six, and the names, nationalities, and residences of the first directors of the corporation are as follows.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: So, 6 po nakalagay dyan, no?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: 6 po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: So, kung ang BOI kailangan ng 4 out of 7 for quorum, ilan naman po sa Cale88 para magkaroon ng quorum? Kung 6 ang kanilang board members.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, we will have to object on the ground of incompetence, Your Honor. I do not know why the prosecution is asking with all due respect. The internal processes of Cale88 Foods Corporation from a Board of Investments witness, Your Honor, on the basis of the requirement of quorum of the BOI. With all due respect, we think that's a stretch. We think it's outright irrelevant.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Erwin, you have to... With your indulgence... Before this witness testified, the Chair already said that your articles of impeachment merely make mention of Cale88 as one of the possible sources of monies of the Vice President. So whether it is actually engaged in business or not is of no moment. In fact, it proves your case, if at all, that

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: it is a regular business as a source of possible

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: revenue. Number two, your witness, Alex Cabrera, described it as a... What was the word, Attorney Justin?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Implausible business model.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Then you can prove that too, but whether you prove that or not, I find that a surplusage on the part, quite frankly, of Attorney Cabrera because he seeks to prove unexplained, undeclared income. And if this is an ongoing business, then the question is, dineclare ba o hindi nang tama? So, why are we nitpicking on... The BOI's official documents on file with their office.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Your Honor, I'm wrapping up and the relevance of this line of questioning goes into the capacity of this entity to conduct business. I will show later on how it's going to be relevant but I'd like to hear the answer. I have a point, Your Honor. I promise that it's going to be relevant, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, please.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Then in that case, Attorney Justin, I think the key word is he's about to wrap up. On that assumption and premise, with your indulgence, Atty. Justin, I'll allow it. Yes.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi ko po alam kung ano yung majority na required nila. Normally po, divided by 2 plus 1 yung alam ko po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: So, apply po natin yung formula nyo. Divided by 2 plus 1 is what?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: 4 po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Okay. Gusto ko sanang ipakita sa inyong 2022 GIS pero object kan. So, diretso tayo sa 2024 GIS.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Tignan niyo po yung list of directors for the 2024 GIS.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Tinitignan ko na po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Ilan po ang directors dyan?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Tatlo po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Sure po kayo? Wala nang iba na lista? Tatlo lang?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Opo, dito po tatlo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: So, less than four. And are you aware po na sa second amended pa lang ng 2022 GIS nitong kumpanyang to, tatlo rin yung directors nila? Aware po kayo doon? Aware po kayo na as early as dung filing nila ng 2022 amended GIS, tatlo lang din po yung nakalagay na board of directors.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi ko po nakita yung 2022 GIS.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Sige, yung 2025, pakita ko po sa inyo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Ilan po ang lumalabas na directors? Nito pong Cale88,

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: dalawa po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Yes, dalawa na lang. So lalong mababa pa sa 4. So kanina nabanggit nyo, hindi makakapag-conduct ng business ang BOI kung walang quorum. Is it the same for companies?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. Misleading. But number two, Your Honor, if I may. I thought he was winding up, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: He already withdrew the question, counsel. Again, it is misleading because they vote based on their shareholdings in the company and the law already allows an OPC. Anyway, Attorney Erwin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Just last few questions. Balikan po natin yung mga affidavits na inattach ni Lourdes Lebosada. For example, itong... May mga affidavits naka-attach sa application nila for... VAT zero rating.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Isa na po dito yung... Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Puntahan natin tong Annex A dun sa VAT zero rating certificate dated 2024. Affidavit po ni Dr. Lourdes Lebosada.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Pakibasa po yung ano, yung first number.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito po yung Annex A.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Annex A dun sa VAT certificate for the year 2024.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: That I have been authorized by the company's board of directors to transact business with BOI relative to our application for BOI certification for VAT zero rating including submission of documents forming part of the firm's application.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Okay, so this is a sworn statement. Pero mukhang maliho yung statement niya na authorized siya by the board kasi by this time wala na pong quorum dahil tatatlo lang yung directors. So how could they authorize her? Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi ko po alam. Basta ito po yung pinagbasihan namin itong sworn.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: So nag-rely lang po kayo kung ano man yung sinabi niya? Whether totoo o hindi.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Sworn and notarized po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Okay, that's all your honor. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Redirect, Attorney Justin. If any?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Kanina po, Sir Perry, tinanong kayo about yung virtual site inspection noong 2021.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Basically, tinanong niya Atty. Erwin at kinumpirman niyo naman na walang tao doon. Could you please explain why the site inspection conducted in 2021 over Cale88 Foods Corporation? Was done virtually, sir.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Pandemic po kasi nun eh. So may mga quarantine health restrictions. Yun po, pandemic po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And just I'll be direct to the point, yung virtual site inspection, how was this applied to all BOI applicants? Was this only for Cale88 Foods Corporation?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi po. Sa lahat po, talagang wala po kaming choice but to go for virtual inspection.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At ulitin ko po, bakit po walang choice yung Board of Investments?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Pandemic po eh.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: 2026, may site inspection ulit. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Apo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At paano po sinigawa yung site inspection noong 2026?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Physical po pumunta yung mga tao po natin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At kanina sinabi niyo po from Manila office. Bakit po physical yung pagpunta? Kumpara noong sa una na virtual lang.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Pwede na po kasing pumunta physically.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now... Tinanong din ni Atty. Erwin kanina na paano nyo daw malalaman kung nag-ooperate talaga yung kumpanya kung hindi nyo naman talagang physically pinupuntahan ng Board of Investments. Now, para lang po malaman ng prosecution, pati ng publiko, paano ba nga kinukumpirma ng ating Board of Investments, isang malaking institution ng ating gobyerno na talagang nag-ooperate yung mga export enterprise nila?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Tinitignan po natin kung meron silang revenue na from exports po. So kagaya po halimbawa yung sinabi ko po kanina na doon po sa report nila sa S1, meron pong nakalagay na export revenue. Tapos po may revenue din po sila doon sa kanilang annual financial statement. Tapos po for certain years, noong 2024,

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Saka nung 2025, nag-apply po sila ng VAT zero rating where for those two years, meron po silang nai-attach na certification ng mga bangko po dun sa inward remittances po nila.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, Sir Perry. Puntahan na naman natin yung mga tanong at mga concerns ng prosecution at pati na po siguro ng ibang tao. Yung mga number of employees ng Cale88 Foods Corporation. Now, I recall, dun sa direct examination natin, may site inspection nung 2026. Ano nga yung discussion with respect to the employees, if you recall, in that site inspection?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Balikan ko lang po. Yung pong naalala ko dito...

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: That question is vague. Actually, I don't understand what the... What

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: was stated in the report, Your Honor? I don't know how that's vague.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: It was what was stated in the report only. Atty. Erwin, you asked for that same table. I believe the one that reflected 51?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: I'm referring to the report on site inspection dated May 18, 2026, Your Honor. There is a finding with respect to the employees. Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I'm asking the witness. Based on the finding during the ocular, Dr. Perry.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Yes, that is correct. Ang sinabi po dito ay based on 2025, during the inspection, the firm's compliance with its terms and conditions has been discussed, particularly its direct labor commitment. For 2025, year 3, the firm had to maintain, so ito po yung commitment nila, direct labor of 39. Based on the 2025 BOI Form S1, the firm had an actual labor of 50, while in 2024, they reported 2,001. So sa record soon namin, may 50 siya, but nagtataka lang ho kami bakit bumaba from 201 to 50.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yung tanong ko po kasi sinabi niyo po na may mga tauhan talaga. In fact, I noticed earlier these were high-ranking officials from the Board of Investments who physically went and conducted the ocular inspection. Mayroon po bang finding dun sa ocular inspection na sinabi tatlo lang yung empleyado ng Cale88 Foods Corporation? Kung mayroon man.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Wala po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, diniscuss din ni Atty. Erwin kanina. Yung sa Board of Investment Form S1, naalala niyo po. Specifically, sinabi niya, wala daw listahan ng empleyado. May requirement na baga na ganyan na dapat ilista lahat ng mga empleyado ng isang export enterprise or any enterprise registered under the Board of Investment under this BOI S1 form? Mayroong requirement?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Wala po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Now, last question. Last question po. Sir, para malaman niyo na nandyan talaga yung export enterprise at nandyan talaga yung produkto, kailangan ba tikman ng Board of Investments ang produkto mismo ng lahat ng enterprise?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Hindi po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: No further questions.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Recross, Atty. Erwin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: None, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Interjection from Senator Judges. Chair recognizes Senator Judge Villanueva. You have two minutes, sir. You may proceed when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Sen. Villanueva will be followed by Sen. Marcos, thereafter Sen. Hontiveros, thereafter Sen. Sotto, Sen. Erwin Tulfo, and Sen. Bam Aquino. And the Senate President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Yes, Mr. Presiding Officer, thank you, Mr. Senate President. Mr. Witness, gusto ko lang pong maintindihan ng gusto, doon sa binabanggit po na GIS, walang nakalagay na empleyado, pero doon sa in-inspect po at Sinumitin na dokumento sa inyo May 115 at nung huli sa site inspection ng May 20, May 2026 ay merong 50. Anong dahilan? Bakit magkaiba po?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ang masasagot ko lang po yung dun sa form namin. Yung pong binabanggit na 50 doon po sa site inspection ay base rin po yun dun sa Form S1 na sinubmit din po nung kumpanya. Notarized. Yun po yung basehan dun sa 50. Hindi po nagbilang yung mga tao namin kung meron talagang 50 na physically na nandun po ng mga tao. Ang basehan po yung kanilang notarized na submission.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Tapos po, binabangga din po natin yung direct labor na yun dun sa annual financial statement din po na sinasubmit nung kumpanya. Tinitignan ko may mga notes to the financial statement din puro na nakalagay yung direct labor po nila.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Tinitignan ko po, January 1, ah, 2021, nagkaroon ng virtual inspection. And then ang next ay May 2026 na.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Limang taon po yung difference.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Bakit to ganung kalahag katagal?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Normally naman po hindi naman po talaga kailangan inspectin dahil meron po kaming nagre-rely po tayo sa mga dokumento na sinasubmit nila. Except dito lang din po nung humingi, ang trigger po nung humingi sila ng Certificate of Good Standing in relation to their BOC registration. Kaya po nung humingi sila nun, nung tinignan po, oh bumaba yung kanyang Labor from 200 to 50. Puntahan natin. Tatignan natin kung ano yung nangyayari sa kanya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: When you inspect, hindi ba tine-check nyo rin kung bakit nung time na binigyan nyo sila ng incentives, part po ng kanilang plano ay mag-employ and siguro hindi na nakalagay doon kung endo or contractual yung magiging part of the employment or seasonal workers. Would that be correct to say?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ang tinitignan po yung actual operation tapos kung may mga tao po, hindi ko alam kung na -check pa.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Just for you to understand where I'm coming from, siyempre yung incentives bibigay mo pero wala ka ng pakialam whether they are submitting to our labor laws. Contractual ba sila? Because I'm just confused, no? A bit confused because zero rank and file yung nakalagay sa GIS. And yet, you have this amount of sales, revenues. I can't believe na lahat ay contractual. Sino mag-handle ng accounting? Treasury, HR, production heads are also outsourced. I don't think yung key positions cannot be... can be outsourced.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Meron naman po silang nakareflect din ng mga administrative staff po. Pero kasi ang commitment po nila sa amin ay yung direct labor. So kaya po yun yung tinitignan natin.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: But the direct labor definition doesn't mean you're regular.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Tama po. At saka po, again po, maikita po namin yung kanilang Yung SSS, ulitin ko lang po, pag nag-apply po sila ng income tax holiday, pero ito hindi nag-a-apply talaga ng, kumbaga po, wala siyang inavail na incentive niya except for the VAT zero rating application for two years.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Sir, last na lang po, I'll go to the second round. Bago o pagkatapos bigyan ng BOI registration ang Cale88. Nagkaroon po ba kayo ng actual inspection, yung before? O ito lang, itong virtual inspection lang po?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Ito lang pong virtual inspection.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: So again, dun sa 2021 to 2026, wala pong nangyaring inspection, walang mabe-verify na operation yung kumpanya,

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Wala po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: walang nakitang packaging facilities, etc.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Wala po. Yun lang pong ano.

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo
turns.text: Noon pong nag-apply sila ng VAT zero rating noong 2024. Part po kasi na ng documentary requirement po namin yung pag-submit ng, at that time po, ng barangay certificate. Barangay certificate po na may nag-ooperate po doon sa lugar na yun noong na ganong kumpanya. Yun lang po yung meron kami.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Are you aware, Dr. Rodolfo, yung China National Township Enterprise na isa sa mga kumpanyang nagpapadala ng pera dito sa Kalye 88 ay wholly owned subsidiary ng China National Agricultural Development Group na isang Chinese state... Owned Enterprise. Mayroon po bang records o disclosures din sa ang BOI na nagpapakita kung ang naturang Chinese company ay isa sa mga investors, buyers, partners ng KL88?

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo

turns.speaker: Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III

turns.text: So as of now, from 2021 hanggang 2025, iba yung 2026, iba na may ari, iba na binenta eh. Pinag-uusapan dito yung 2021-2025. Sinasabi nyo, wala. Hindi sila nag-avail ng kahit anong tax incentives from BOI.
